By the instant petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner has claimed the following relief (s):-
"(i) This Hon'ble Court be pleased to direct/issue a writ of Mandamus to the respondents to constitute the Special Agency/SIT (Special Investigation Team) CBI (Central Bureau of Investigation) by changing the Investigation Officer (Respondent no.5) for fair investigation to be done and the same be done and reported to the respondent of under the supervision IG level authority.
(ii) This Hon'ble Court be also to direct for making accused to the instant Case Praveen Asthana (Spl. Investigating Officer being newly wedded deceased within 1 year of the marriage) with the Nanad Pooja Sharma @ Priyanka Sharma W/o. Anurag Shrivastava (Respondent no.7) of the deceased and Chacha Sasur Suraj Sharma S/o.
Shri Ramavtar Sharma (Respondent No.8) and also to reinvestigate the incidence dated 12.09.2022 of 01.30 A.M. and also to register the case respondent no.5,7 & 8 to initially registered the case and add the section 302, 201, 120-B of IPC along with 304(B), 498A, 34 IPC R/w 3,4 Dowry Act along with other relevant section looking to fact and the investigation in FIR of Crime No.491/2022 dated 16.09.2022.
(iii) This Hon'ble Court is also be pleased to direct the respondents to special agency be engaged for the fair investigation and documents filed with the Annexure be taken for investigation.

(iv) This Hon'ble Court also pleased to direct the Change Investigation Officer to take the evidence and also under Section 164 CrPC evidence before the Magistrate which conclude the fairness in the investigation.

sentences.text: As per counsel for the petitioner, his main contention is that the police is not investigating the case properly registered vide Crime No. 491/2022 under Sections 304-B, 498-A and 34 of Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
According to the learned counsel, the postmortem report clearly reveals that some injuries were noticed by the doctor over the body of the deceased and those injuries were antemortum in nature.
He submits that considering the over all circumstances existing and the position in which body of the deceased was recovered, it is clear that it is a case of 302 of IPC but not of 304-B of IPC.
Therefore, he is asking a direction for the authority to conduct a proper investigation in the matter and also for registration of offence under Section 302 against the accused persons.

Reply has been filed by the respondent/State stating therein that the charge-sheet has been filed and if proper investigation is not being conducted by the police then the petitioner has an alternative remedy to raise his grievance before the court of competent jurisdiction under Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C.

He submits that the Supreme Court in case of State of Bihar Vs. J.A.C. Saldanha and Others 1980(1) SCC 554 has observed that the Magistrate is having full power to direct the investigating agency for further investigation if it is noticed that proper investigation has not been done.

entities.text: State of Bihar Vs. J.A.C. Saldanha and Others 1980(1) SCC 554
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that the charge-sheet has already been filed under Section 178(3) of Cr.P.C., and the Court has to take cognizance in the matter and the Court below is fully competent to frame additional charge of Section 302 of IPC if on the basis of existing circumstances, the Court comes to the conclusion that case should also be tried under Section 302 of IPC in addition to the case of Section 304-B of IPC.

He submits that petitioner may raise this objection before the Court below and can convince the Court for framing the charge under Section 302 of IPC and as such, no further investigation only for the purpose to register an offence under Section 302 of IPC is required especially when investigation has properly been done and charge-sheet has been filed.

He further submits that not only this, the trial Court is also competent to add additional accused in the matter if on the basis of material collected, it comes to the conclusion that other accused persons are also involved in the crime and they are to be made accused then appropriate order can be passed by the Court and even though petitioner can make a request before the Court below and try to convince the Court below that other persons whatever may be, if involved in the case, should be made accused but he submits that under such a circumstance, directing C.B.I. to make an enquiry or to constitute a special independent team for investigation, is not necessary.

Shri Sanjay Sarwate, learned counsel appearing for respondent no.5 has filed an objection and supported the stand taken by counsel for the respondent/State and submitted that in the facts and circumstances of the case when charge-sheet has been filed, the petitioner has every right to approach the Court below and point out as to why the case should have been registered under Section 302 of IPC and in turn, the Court below can add other accused if in the existing facts and Dharmistha Bhatt vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198680583/
3 circumstances, the Court comes to the conclusion that persons who ought to be made accused have not been made accused but asking that enquiry be handed over to some special agency is not proper.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and perusal of record, I find force in the submission made by learned counsel for the respondents saying that if the trial Court is also of the opinion that the death occurs in the suspicious circumstance then the offence of Section 302 of IPC can be added and tried the accused persons with Sections 304-B and 302 of IPC, but at this stage, this Court is not going to that whether any offence of 302 is made out or not.

At the most,
the petitioner can make an application before the Court below and convince the Court that in the existing circumstances, some other persons were also to be made accused but prosecution has not included them in the array of accused and the trial Court can take cognizance of the same and if so requires, can also pass an order making the other persons an accused, but at this stage, I am not inclined to enter into merits of the case or to issue any direction.
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed.
